item.title: The Harness: What Actually Makes an AI Agent Work
item.description: In his post “Agent Harness Engineering”, Addy Osmani argues that most conversation about AI coding tools has centered on the model itself, which one reasons best, which one writes the cleanest code, and that this misses half the system. A model on its own is not an agent. It becomes one only once it is given a way to read and write files, run commands, and know when a task is actually finished. Osmani, building on a term coined by Viv Trivedy, calls this surrounding structure the harness.
